component.name: GeminiDesk
component.summary: Lightweight native Rust desktop client for Google Gemini

description.p: Features include a single shared WebView across Main Window, Quick Chat, and Floating Companion, Wayland XDG Desktop Portal integration (GlobalShortcuts, Screenshot, Settings color scheme), StatusNotifierItem system tray for KDE Plasma, and opt-in productivity workflows.

Fixes Linux WebKitGTK UI stuttering by restoring GPU-accelerated compositing via WEBKIT_DMABUF_RENDERER_FORCE_SHM=1 on WebKitGTK 2.44+ (increasing live Gemini frame rates from 13–20 FPS to 87–111 FPS while preserving multi-window reparenting), preserves decoded WebKit memory caches across transient Balanced-mode hides, and eliminates redundant GTK visibility redraws.

First public stable release featuring native Google account-switching navigation (Back to Gemini and Cancel), full KDE Plasma 6 Wayland integration (XDG GlobalShortcuts, Screenshot, Settings, Klipper clipboard, and native desktop notifications), WebKitGTK background memory trimming, and Ed25519-verified automatic updates.
Cross-platform beta with Linux Wayland/KDE Plasma portal integration, macOS bundle infrastructure, native Windows installer, and Ed25519-verified automatic updates.
